_note: Source of truth for the catalogue. Items come from the owner's photos; price is read from the filename (30k = ₦30,000). Titles/descriptions describe only what is visible.

products.title: Velvet & Gold Cut-Out Gown
products.description: A black velvet bodice cut into a sharp asymmetric line, flowing into a molten gold skirt that falls straight to the floor. Architectural and unapologetically glamorous. Add a wide-brim hat and you are the editorial.

products.title: White Halter Ruffle Gown
products.description: A high halter neckline and a fitted white bodice that breaks into an asymmetric cascade of ruffles. Bridal-adjacent, pure and dramatic. Picture it at a white party, an engagement shoot or your birthday dinner.

products.title: Cobalt Draped Jumpsuit
products.description: Cobalt blue with sheer long sleeves and a sweeping drape that wraps from the shoulder across the body. From the front it reads like a gown; underneath, the ease of trousers. Elegance you can actually move in.

products.title: Cobalt Mesh-Sleeve Draped Gown
products.description: Royal cobalt with sheer mesh sleeves, a gathered bodice and a draped sash that sweeps into a flared hem. Regal, covered and full of movement. The gown for a church anniversary, a wedding or a family celebration.

products.title: White Wide-Leg & Floral Bustier Set
products.description: Crisp white wide-leg trousers, a floral halter bustier and a sheer white overshirt. A fresh, fashion-forward three-part look for brunch, a boat day or a white-themed party.

products.title: Bronze Draped Keyhole Gown
products.description: A shimmering bronze pattern, a keyhole neckline and long sleeves, with a dramatic drape gathered across the hip. It comes with its inner, so you can wear it with total confidence. Old-Hollywood glamour, Lagos style.

products.title: Ivory Cowl Mermaid Gown
products.description: Ivory draped into a deep cowl neckline, ruched through the hips and released into a mermaid hem. Soft, sculptural and luminous. Imagine it at a traditional wedding reception or a candlelit dinner.

products.title: Midnight Cowl Mermaid Gown
products.description: Deep midnight indigo with a soft cowl neckline, long sleeves and a hem that spreads into a small train. Mysterious and grown-up. The gown for evenings when you want quiet, undeniable elegance.

products.title: White Off-Shoulder Drape Gown
products.description: A luminous white column with an off-shoulder neckline and a long draped panel that trails behind you. Clean lines, soft sheen, serious presence. For white parties, bridal events and elegant evenings.

products.title: Fuchsia & Print Mermaid Gown
products.description: A fuchsia off-shoulder bodice set against a bold printed mermaid skirt. Joyful, colourful and proudly statement. Wear it to an owambe and watch the photographers find you.

products.title: Cerise Rosette Mini Dress
products.description: A sweetheart neckline, short sleeves and a skirt built from layers of sculpted rosette ruffles. Flirty, romantic and made for celebration. Your birthday dress has entered the chat.

products.title: Ruched Cut-Out Column Gown
products.description: A sculpted cut-out neckline, long sleeves and all-over ruching with ruffled edges that trace your silhouette to the floor. It is the definition of body-confident. Choose cobalt to stand out, black to own the night or red to do both.

products.title: Rust Ruched Wrap Maxi
products.description: Warm rust with a wrap V-neck, long sleeves and ruching that shapes every curve down to the ankle. Rich colour, flattering lines and easy to accessorise with gold. A festive-season favourite in the making.

products.title: Red Cut-Out Twist Maxi
products.description: A red maxi with a sculpted cut-out neckline, long sleeves and a twisted gather at the hip. Sleek, sensual and sure of itself. Red lipstick optional, compliments guaranteed.

products.title: Red Twist-Front Slit Maxi
products.description: A clean red maxi with long sleeves, a twisted front and a front slit that shows just enough. Elegant enough for church, bold enough for dinner.

products.title: Turquoise Off-Shoulder Ruched Maxi
products.description: Bright turquoise with a soft off-shoulder neckline and ruching that sculpts through the hips before falling to the floor. Fresh, vibrant and holiday-ready.

products.title: Turquoise Cut-Out Pleated Maxi
products.description: A cut-out neckline and fitted long-sleeve bodice meet a softly pleated skirt that floats as you walk. Graceful and bright, it looks beautiful in motion.

products.title: Royal Blue Plunge Maxi
products.description: Royal blue with a deep plunge, long sleeves, a cut-out waist and a skirt that pours to the floor. Bold neckline, fluid movement, total presence.

products.title: White Ruffle-Front Ruched Maxi
products.description: Delicate straps, a ruched white body and a line of ruffles running down the centre. Soft and romantic with a body-hugging shape. Perfect for white-themed parties and summer evenings.

products.title: Polka Dot Long-Sleeve Maxi
products.description: A tiny polka dot print on a long-sleeve maxi with a gently flared skirt. Classic, modest and quietly stylish. Wear it to church, the office or a family lunch.

products.title: Fuchsia Off-Shoulder Drape Gown
products.description: Vivid fuchsia with an off-shoulder neckline, long sleeves and a draped panel that falls from the hip. Photogenic from every angle. The colour of celebration.

products.title: Blue Print One-Shoulder Maxi
products.description: A blue and green print draped over one shoulder and wrapped close to the body. Artful, fluid and full of life. Holiday dinners and garden parties, this one is for you.

products.title: Black Lace-Sleeve Ruched Mini
products.description: A ruched black mini with a cut-out neckline and sheer lace sleeves. Sensual, curve-loving and made for night. Add red heels and a small bag and the look is complete.

products.title: Tiered Strappy Midi Dress
products.description: Thin straps, a gathered bodice and a tiered skirt that swings below the knee. Light, feminine and easy. In red for joy, in black for evening.

products.title: Violet Cut-Out Jumpsuit
products.description: Deep violet with long sleeves, circular cut-outs at the neckline and wide legs that sweep the floor. Chic, comfortable and completely striking.

products.title: Red Keyhole Jumpsuit
products.description: A fitted red jumpsuit with keyhole cut-outs, long sleeves and flared legs. One zip, one look, all confidence. From the office to dinner without changing a thing.

products.title: Colour-Block Tiered Mini Dress
products.description: Fuchsia, orange and blush tiers with flutter sleeves. Happy, breezy and effortlessly fun. Sunglasses on, shoulder bag ready, weekend unlocked.
details: Fuchsia, orange and blush colour block

products.title: Olive Ruched Bodycon Midi
products.description: A rich olive midi with a V-neck and ruching from bust to hem that celebrates every curve. Unexpected colour, flawless fit.

products.title: Red Ruched Tie-Sleeve Mini
products.description: A red ruched mini with a V-neck and long sleeves finished with trailing ties. Flirty, fitted and fun to move in.

products.title: Red Sweetheart Ruched Mini
products.description: A sweetheart neckline, long sleeves and deep ruching in bold red. Short, sculpting and made for a night out.

products.title: Yellow Strapless Tulle Trail Gown
products.description: Butter-yellow strapless bodice with ruched detail and a side cut-out, flowing into a cathedral-length trail of soft tulle. Ethereal, editorial and impossible to ignore. Built for the camera and every eye in the room.

products.title: Black Velvet Gold Structured Gown
products.description: A fitted black long-sleeve bodice meets a sculptural gold metallic skirt with ruched hip detail and a sweeping train. Dramatic, architectural and made for the entrance everyone notices. The gown that photographs itself.

products.title: Red Cut-Out Circle Wide-Leg Jumpsuit
products.description: Round-neck, long sleeves and circular cut-outs across the chest, finishing in wide flared legs. Clean, bold and completely self-assured. The kind of jumpsuit that needs no accessories to make a statement.

products.title: Off-Shoulder Bishop-Sleeve Tiered Maxi
products.description: A gathered off-shoulder neckline, voluminous bishop sleeves and a softly pleated tiered skirt that pools to the floor. Graceful, full-of-movement and available in lilac, deep purple or hot pink. The definition of effortless glamour.

products.title: Tropical Floral Wrap Set
products.description: A rich tropical floral print in orange, green and white on a wrap-style piece that works as a full-length maxi wrap or tied as a skirt. Comes as a dress-and-skirt set. Vibrant, versatile and styled entirely by you.
details: Wearable as maxi dress or skirt

products.title: Fuchsia & Paisley Bodycon Maxi
products.description: A bold fuchsia off-shoulder top fused into a vibrant paisley-print bodycon skirt. The contrast between the solid colour and the print makes every angle interesting. Wear it to a wedding, an owambe or anywhere you want to be seen.

products.title: Pink Colour-Block Tiered Bow Maxi
products.description: Tie-shoulder bows, a square bodice and a floor-length tiered skirt that moves from pale blush to fuchsia to deep red. Festive, voluminous and full of colour. The gown that turns a party into a celebration.

products.title: Purple Wrap Collar Wide-Leg Jumpsuit
products.description: A deep V-neck with a collar, long sleeves, a self-tie waist belt and wide-leg trousers in rich purple. Polished and comfortable in equal measure. The jumpsuit that does the work of a gown without sacrificing ease.

products.title: Sky Blue One-Shoulder Pleated Maxi
products.description: A gathered one-shoulder neckline over a fitted bodice, releasing into a softly pleated chiffon skirt that fans into a subtle train in sky blue. Airy, elegant and beautiful in motion.

products.title: Red Draped-Shoulder Wide-Leg Jumpsuit
products.description: A dramatic drape that sweeps from the shoulder across the chest and trails to the side, worn over wide-leg trousers. Sleek, sculptural and completely commanding. Bold red from head to toe.

products.title: White Polka Dot Ruffle Off-Shoulder Mini
products.description: Classic black polka dots on white with an off-shoulder neckline, voluminous ruffled long sleeves and a tiered frill hem. Playful, vintage-inspired and completely fun to wear. Styled with red heels it becomes its own occasion.

products.title: Flame Print Halter Maxi
products.description: A swirling flame and tiger print in burnt orange, black and tan on a sleeveless halter-neck maxi that falls straight to the floor. Bold, arresting and impossible to ignore. The print is the statement.
details: Flame print in orange and black

products.title: Off-Shoulder Ruffle-Tier Mini
products.description: A gathered off-shoulder neckline in royal blue or a criss-cross halter in red, both with a fitted bodice and a full tiered ruffle skirt. Flirty, festive and made for dancing. Pick your colour, pack your heels.

products.title: Red Cold-Shoulder Floral Print Maxi
products.description: Long sleeves with a cold-shoulder cut-out in a vivid orange-red and black abstract floral print. The silhouette falls straight to the floor while the print takes centre stage. Vibrant, elegant and made for celebrations.

products.title: Blue Abstract One-Shoulder Cape Maxi
products.description: A cerulean blue splashed with yellow-green abstract brushstrokes on a one-shoulder fitted column with a cape detail. Artistic, vivid and modern. The kind of gown that starts conversations.

products.title: Royal Blue Ruffle Crop & Skirt Set
products.description: A gathered crop top with dramatic bishop sleeves, paired with a tiered ruffle mini skirt in rich royal blue. The layered ruffles move with you and look stunning from every angle. A co-ord that does not need extra accessories.

products.title: Red Ruffle-Tier Long-Sleeve Mini
products.description: Long sleeves, a V-neckline and a cascading multi-tier ruffle skirt in bold red. Short, feminine and unmistakably festive. A birthday dinner dress, a night out dress and a love-at-first-sight dress all in one.

products.title: Geometric Colour-Block Twist Maxi
products.description: Bold geometric blocks of royal blue, red, purple and white with a gathered twist at the hip. Short sleeves, a round neckline and a floor-length silhouette that wears as joyfully or seriously as you choose.

products.title: Fuchsia Colour-Block Ruffle Cap-Sleeve Mini
products.description: Three tiers of fuchsia, orange and pale pink with ruffled cap sleeves. Colour-popping and playful in the best way. Made for birthday celebrations, brunch with the girls and every other moment that deserves a great photo.

products.title: Royal Blue Cape-Sleeve Mini
products.description: A deep V-neckline and a sculptural cape that drapes into dramatic batwing sleeves over a fitted mini skirt. In royal blue that catches every light. Bold, architectural and completely effortless to wear.

products.title: Purple Asymmetric Bell-Sleeve Mini
products.description: A striking purple mini with an asymmetric V-neckline and flared bell sleeves that widen dramatically at the wrist. Short, sharp and fully electric. Add heels and a small bag for a night you will remember.

products.title: Dark Floral Mesh-Sleeve Cut-Out Mini
products.description: A dark base bursting with bold fuchsia and orange florals, sheer mesh long sleeves and a cut-out neckline detail. Ruched through the body for a curve-hugging fit. Sultry, feminine and completely eye-catching.

products.title: Navy Polka Dot Collar Mini
products.description: A collared V-neckline, short sleeves and a pleated mini skirt in a classic navy polka dot print. Vintage-inspired, crisp and completely versatile. Wear it with sneakers for the day or heels for the evening.

products.title: Gold Leopard Ruffle-Hem Mini
products.description: Gold and brown leopard print with short sleeves and a ruffled hem that swings as you move. Fierce, fun and always in season. Accessorise with nude heels and gold jewellery for an instant editorial.

products.title: Lime Green Cut-Out Long-Sleeve Mini
products.description: Electric lime green with double cut-outs at the neckline, long sleeves and a flared skater skirt. High-energy, high-impact and impossible to ignore. When you want to walk in and be the mood.

products.title: Red & Black Abstract Bodycon Mini
products.description: A long-sleeve square-neck bodycon mini in a vivid red and black abstract print. Fitted, bold and ready for the night. Pair it with black heels and a small bag to let the pattern do all the talking.

products.title: Pink Paisley Cut-Out Ruched Mini
products.description: A vibrant pink and blue paisley print on a long-sleeve mini with a cut-out neckline and ruching that gathers along the sides. Fun, curve-loving and impossible to pass up at this price.
